criteria.requirement: Reject unsafe images, unapproved sessions and concurrent resources without poisoning first use
Snapshot eligible current regular source without host authority, links or tracked deletions
Run explicit bounded commands in the constrained container without invoking image entrypoints
Inspect source diffs only after confirmed shutdown while preserving owner files
Owner CLI Stop interrupts active commands and crash recovery confirms resource removal
Scope owner commands to the managed session without changing approval or task completion authority
